title: A row one lane deletes from docs/debts/notes.md stays deleted when another lane in the same batch appends next to it
why: Lane notes-fix-guard-1 (session_013NEJL3G6vFtN2TjNZrMETW), 13:12 CST Nov 8: under `.gitattributes` merge=union for docs/debts/notes.md, a row one lane deletes comes back when another lane in the same batch appends next to it. Proven in a scratch repo by #1920 round 2 (sonnet): lane A deletes the last note, lane B appends after it, and the integration merge revives the row. `check_silent_undo.py --strict --upstream <base> --head integ` exits 0; it catches a revival only when the deletion is already on main. Decision notes-merge-union's text is being corrected to say so and to cite this step.
note: Sighting (lane push-head-upstream-name, 13:39 CST Nov 8): the union driver brought deleted lines back into #1852 and #2199 today. Sighting (coordinator 14:45 CST Nov 8, from lane mcp-tools-in-guard-matcher): main holds 9 duplicate note keys in docs/debts/notes.md from union merges (for example handoff-unread, opus-plain-ask). #1687 f4fc22ad9 repairs only its own re-added lines. The 9 duplicates on main need a one-time clean-up, owned here.
